hints.title: Sort Products Lexicographically
hints.text: Sorting products ascending ensures that candidates matching any prefix appear in natural alphabetical priority.

hints.title: Narrow Prefix Search Window
hints.text: For each incremental typed character, binary search for the first product having the current prefix.

hints.title: Extract at Most 3 Matches
hints.text: Take up to three consecutive products starting from the lower bound that match the typed prefix.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.time: O(N log N + L * log N)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Filtering the full product list for every typed letter requires O(L * N) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting once allows logarithmic lookup for each typed prefix with O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate can implement this via prefix binary search or a trie storing top 3 indices per node.
complexity.notes: Output array contains L lists, each having at most 3 strings.
